# Starfighters Space Plans Pathfinder for Payload Processing Under MOU with The Bionetics Corporation


September 02, 2026 9:00am EDT


*The Bionetics Corporation to provide specialized services and facilities for small-payload captive-carry and air-launch missions*


KENNEDY SPACE CENTER, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Starfighters Space, Inc.](https://starfightersspace.com/) **("Starfighters" or the "Company") (NYSE American: FJET),** the space company operating the world's only commercial fleet of flight-ready Mach 2+ supersonic aircraft, today announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) with[The Bionetics Corporation](https://www.bionetics.com/) (“Bionetics”) to integrate and process a series of pathfinder small payloads for missions aboard the Company’s F-104 aircraft.


Under the MOU, Bionetics will work with Starfighters to prepare multiple classes of small payloads, including their pre-flight and post-flight assembly, testing, integration, and data retrieval, using Bionetics’ specialized laboratories, equipment, and personnel within the Space Life Sciences Lab at the Cape Canaveral Spaceport.


“Bionetics manages some world-class processing capabilities for NASA research payloads and spaceflight hardware, and their facilities are conveniently located alongside ours in the Space Life Sciences Lab at the Kennedy Space Center,” said Tim Franta, CEO of Starfighters Space. “Working with Bionetics, we will use these first payloads as pathfinders to determine the array of equipment and services required for future[Wind Tunnel in the Sky](https://starfightersspace.com/starfighters-space-advances-wind-tunnel-in-the-sky-mach-2-flight-testing-platform/) ™ and[STARLAUNCH](https://starfightersspace.com/operations/) ™ missions.”


Located at the Cape Canaveral Spaceport, just nine miles from Starfighters’ hangar, the Space Life Sciences Lab is a 104,000-square-foot facility with dozens of laboratories that support NASA and commercial space activities, including processing microsatellites and conducting spaceflight experiments. Both Starfighters and Bionetics are housed within the facility, which is also home to Space Florida, multiple universities, and other space companies.


**About Starfighters Space, Inc.**


[Starfighters Space](https://starfightersspace.com/) (NYSE American: FJET), with a fleet of F-104 aircraft based at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida and the Midland International Air and Space Port in Texas, is the only company in the world with the commercial capability to fly at sustained Mach 2+ speeds for a variety of aerospace applications. The iconic F-104 jets are configurable as a platform for air-launched payloads, training for pilots, and to support *research, development, test, and evaluation* (RDT&E) for hypersonic technologies, advanced materials, missile defense systems, microgravity science, spaceflight hardware validation, and defense electronic systems.
